title: Our Work Highlighted in Nature Catalysis News & Views
content: Our recent article on electrode-alternating ammonia splitting was featured in a News & Views article in Nature Catalysis. The commentary highlights the potential of electrode alternation for efficient and durable ammonia electrolysis, offering new perspectives for hydrogen production from ammonia.
highlightText: Our electrode-alternating ammonia splitting work was highlighted in Nature Catalysis News & Views.

title: Paper Published in Nature Catalysis
content: Our article, “Ammonia Splitting with Electrode Alternating for Durable Hydrogen Production”, has been published online in Nature Catalysis. This work demonstrates an electrode-alternating strategy for durable hydrogen production from ammonia and provides a new approach to overcoming catalyst poisoning in ammonia electrolysis.
highlightText: Our latest research article was published online in Nature Catalysis.

title: China–Africa Low-Carbon Catalysis Workshop Held
content: The China–Africa Low-Carbon Catalysis Workshop was held on 19 May, bringing together our team and researchers from the University of South Africa for in-depth discussions on low-carbon catalysis, green hydrogen technologies, and future collaborative opportunities.
highlightText: The China–Africa Low-Carbon Catalysis Workshop was successfully held with the University of South Africa team.
